edges.reason: msg.sender is checked by the auth modifier before setOwner mutates owner.
msg.sender is supplied as src to isAuthorized for the authorization decision.
authority.canCall is invoked inside isAuthorized to grant or deny access.
owner is compared inside isAuthorized for privileged callers.
admin is required for setOwnerByAdmin to change owner.
onlyOwner requires owner==msg.sender before kill executes.
onlyOwner guards withdrawStuckFunds before owner receives funds.
kill invokes selfdestruct after passing the onlyOwner check.
withdrawStuckFunds transfers ETH/ERC20 to the owner.
tx.origin drives the automatic vs manual fee decision.
The tx.origin bot check lowers the AaveHelper service fee.
The tx.origin bot check lowers the CompoundSaverHelper service fee.
changeMonitor writes now into changeRequestedTimestamp.
confirmNewMonitor compares block.timestamp against CHANGE_PERIOD.
Timestamp is stored to gate the monitor change procedure.
Timestamp comparison finalizes the monitor change.
onlyMonitor requires msg.sender==monitor before callExecute runs.
callExecute makes the user's DSProxy perform an external call before returning leftover ETH.
The external DSProxy.execute can re-enter callExecute before the balance-driven transfer.
callProxy verifies the signer using ecrecover over a signed digest.
onlyAuthorized gates callProxy via authorized[msg.sender].
callProxy triggers DSProxy.execute which performs an arbitrary external call.
write uses inline assembly create to deploy the supplied code.
The _code parameter is deployed verbatim by the assembly create.
openLeveragedLoan invokes the Aave flashLoan external call.
openLeveragedLoan builds paramsData before the flashLoan call.
paramsData is forwarded to the flashLoan receiver as callback payload.
loanAmount local is derived from the user exchange srcAmount.
openWithLoan calls lendingPool.flashLoan.
closeWithLoan calls lendingPool.flashLoan.
flashLoan invokes executeOperation on the receiver with attacker-influenced params.
CompoundSaverProxy.repay forwards remaining ETH to tx.origin.
givePermission authorizes a contract that can later cause execute on the DSProxy.
owner_ parameter is assigned to the owner state variable in setOwner.
_amount parameter is used to compute feeAmount in AaveHelper.getFee.
Low-level arbitrary call enables reentrant execution of flash loan callback.
calcGasCost result feeds monitor-initiated flash loan executions.

normalization_plan.reason: The owner_ parameter only exists to feed the owner assignment inside setOwner and has no independent semantics.
_amount is a transient argument used solely to compute feeAmount within getFee.
_code is consumed directly by the assembly create in write and is meaningless outside it.
loanAmount is a local derived from exchange data only used to size the flashLoan call.
paramsData is a transient local whose only role is to feed the flashLoan callback payload.
